name: Patient
definition: A person receiving care, recorded once in the Patient table with demographic attributes (sex, birth date, admission type), a first visit date, a free-text disease diagnosis and an optional record description date.
scope: Root entity for patient-level counting, filtering and demographic reporting in this database.

name: Patient Identifier
definition: The numeric identifier that uniquely identifies a patient. The same identifier value is reused as the linking key on the Examination and Laboratory tables.
scope: Linking Patient, Examination and Laboratory records; also the identifier returned when a question asks to list patients by their ID.

name: Sex
definition: The recorded sex of the patient, stored as a single-letter code on the patient record.
scope: Demographic grouping and filtering when a question says female or male.

name: Birth Date
definition: The patient's date of birth, stored as a calendar date on the patient record.
scope: Source for age computation and for birth-year cohort filters.

name: Age
definition: The patient's age. It is not stored as a column; it is derived from the birth date relative to the current date at year granularity.
scope: Age-based filtering such as patients who are not yet 70, and age averaging.

name: Admission Type
definition: Whether the patient was an inpatient or an outpatient, stored as a single-character code on the patient record.
scope: Inpatient versus outpatient comparisons and their proportion within a sex subgroup.

name: First Visit Date
definition: The date on which the patient first attended the facility, stored on the patient record.
scope: Patient-level date information and a candidate referent for loosely phrased temporal filters, distinct from examination dates and laboratory test dates.

name: Disease Diagnosis
definition: The free-text disease label or labels recorded for a patient at the patient level. A record may hold several disease labels at once and may qualify a label as suspected.
scope: Answering what disease a patient is diagnosed with, and grouping or filtering patients by a disease label.

name: Examination-Stage Diagnosis
definition: The disease label recorded on an individual examination, representing the disease assessment at the time of that examination rather than the patient-level diagnosis.
scope: Examination-level disease assessment, which is frequently unrecorded.

name: Systemic Lupus Erythematosus (SLE)
definition: One of the disease labels occurring in the diagnosis vocabulary; a specific autoimmune disease category that is not given its own entity in the schema.
scope: Disease-specific patient selection, for example patients diagnosed with SLE.

name: Examination
definition: An examination event for a patient, holding the examination date together with serological, coagulation and thrombosis findings.
scope: Source of coagulation, antiphospholipid, antinuclear antibody, thrombosis and symptom observations.

name: Examination Date
definition: The calendar date on which an examination was performed.
scope: Temporal filtering of examination-level findings.

name: Laboratory Test
definition: A laboratory test record for a patient on a given date, holding the measured biochemical, haematological, immunological and inflammatory analyte values of that panel.
scope: Source of all measured laboratory analytes and their values.

name: Laboratory Test Date
definition: The calendar date on which a laboratory test panel was performed.
scope: Temporal filtering of laboratory results and listing of the dates of a patient's laboratory tests.

name: Clinical Symptom
definition: Free-text description of the symptoms recorded for a patient at an examination. Presence of a value indicates recorded symptoms; absence of a value indicates that no symptom was recorded.
scope: Presence or absence of symptoms at examination level.

name: Serum Albumin
definition: Blood albumin concentration measured within a laboratory test panel; a nutritional and hepatic synthetic marker.
scope: Filtering and averaging of blood albumin level.

name: Platelet Count
definition: Platelet count measured within a laboratory test panel; a haematological marker relevant to coagulopathy.
scope: Platelet-based filtering of patients.

name: GPT (ALT) Transaminase Level
definition: Glutamic pyruvic transaminase, also called alanine aminotransferase (ALT), measured within a laboratory test panel; a hepatic marker.
scope: Liver enzyme filtering and history-of-elevation reasoning.

name: Blood Glucose
definition: Blood glucose concentration measured within a laboratory test panel.
scope: Glucose range filtering.

name: Total Cholesterol
definition: Total serum cholesterol measured within a laboratory test panel.
scope: Cholesterol range filtering.

name: Creatinine
definition: Serum creatinine concentration measured within a laboratory test panel; a renal function marker.
scope: Renal function filtering.

name: Urea Nitrogen
definition: Blood urea nitrogen measured within a laboratory test panel; a renal function marker.
scope: Urea nitrogen boundary-value filtering.

name: Creatinine Phosphokinase
definition: Creatine (creatinine) phosphokinase activity measured within a laboratory test panel; a muscle damage marker.
scope: Muscle enzyme range filtering.

name: Immunoglobulin Level
definition: Serum immunoglobulin concentration measured per isotype (IgG, IgA, IgM) within a laboratory test panel, each isotype carrying its own reference interval.
scope: Immunoglobulin range filtering per isotype.

name: C-Reactive Protein
definition: C-reactive protein measurement recorded within a laboratory test panel; an acute-phase inflammation marker. Negative and positive results are recorded as text qualifiers alongside numeric measurements.
scope: Inflammation status filtering.

name: Antinuclear Antibody Titer
definition: The numeric dilution titer of antinuclear antibodies recorded on an examination, expressed on a power-of-four scale.
scope: Quantifying antinuclear antibody positivity; distinct from the reported staining pattern.

name: ANA Staining Pattern
definition: The fluorescent staining pattern code reported for the antinuclear antibody assay on an examination, such as S, P, D or N and their combinations.
scope: Selecting examinations by antinuclear antibody pattern.

name: Anti-Cardiolipin Antibody
definition: Anti-cardiolipin antibody concentration recorded per isotype (IgG, IgM, IgA) on an examination; an antiphospholipid antibody relevant to thrombosis.
scope: Antiphospholipid antibody level filtering, averaging and comparison against an average.

name: Coagulation Inhibitor Test
definition: A panel of lupus-anticoagulant related coagulation screening tests (KCT, RVVT, LAC) recorded on an examination, each as a positive or negative result.
scope: Determining whether a patient has a positive degree of coagulation.

name: Degree of Thrombosis
definition: An ordinal severity grade of thrombosis recorded on an examination.
scope: Thrombotic severity filtering such as thrombosis level 2.

name: Extractable Nuclear Antigen Antibody
definition: A family of specific antinuclear autoantibody tests (anti-Scl70, anti-SSA, anti-SSB, anti-centromere, anti-RNP, anti-Sm) recorded in a laboratory panel, each reported either as a numeric titer or as the literal value negative.
scope: Filtering patients by a normal or abnormal specific autoantibody result.
